description: An oscillator whose wave is built from a rational function, shaped by three parameters, with two related waves coming out at once

params.text: Sets the pitch, 0 giving C0 at 16.35Hz and each whole step up an octave, over a range of six octaves
Sets the depth of the linear through-zero frequency modulation from the fm jack, none at the far left
Sets where the peak of the wave falls, between the start of the cycle and the zero crossing that c sets
Sets where the wave passes seven tenths of its peak, between the peak that a sets and the zero crossing that c sets
Sets where the wave crosses zero within the cycle; at the centre there is no distortion and the wave is symmetrical
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, on the a CV
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, on the b CV
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, on the c CV

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at a volt per octave, added to the pitch knob; the number of channels here sets the polyphony of the whole module
Modulates the frequency linearly and through zero, scaled by the fm knob
Adds to the a knob through its attenuverter, a volt covering a tenth of its travel at full attenuation
Adds to the b knob through its attenuverter, a volt covering a tenth of its travel at full attenuation
Adds to the c knob through its attenuverter, a volt covering a tenth of its travel at full attenuation

outputs.text: The first of the two waves, up to 5V either way
The second of the two waves, up to 5V either way

notes: with all three shape knobs at the centre the two waves are close to a sine
the two waves swap over between odd- and even-numbered polyphony channels, which spreads a chord across both outputs
the display draws both waves with seven marked points on each, the first wave yellow and the second red
menu: Quantize pitch knob: Continuous, Semitones, Octaves — snaps the pitch knob only, leaving the V/oct input unquantised
Restrict parameters (antialiasing) — holds the three shape knobs inside a range that keeps aliasing down; the range is wider at lower pitches and higher sample rates

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
